integrity: All counting assertions have a full algebraic proof; an included standalone checker exhaustively tests eleven small graph-field combinations. Finite verification is corroboration, not a proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact matching sum applies to graphs with no even cycle; for graphs with an even cycle only failure of support-rigidity is established, not the full target-fiber distribution. The bowtie is not bracket-surjective. Some earlier structural and frequency-rank results are inputs and historical priority against unlocated equivalences remains unresolved.
title: Even-cycle obstruction to support-rigid bracket fibers in graphical Lie algebras
